scope: EntityOS runtime artifact-authority closure after parallel MicroVM reentry

parallel_reentry.detail: Parallel current-main work removed CLAYVERSE_ENTITYOS_SHA256 from the Kata deployment Secret surface and documented image authority. This organ retained that delta and closed the remaining service-side runtime override path instead of creating a competing deployment implementation.

finding.observed: entityos.lock.json declared the tracked lock as sole artifact authority while service.py still accepted CLAYVERSE_ENTITYOS_PATH and CLAYVERSE_ENTITYOS_SHA256 as runtime selectors.
finding.counter_reality: A deployment/runtime environment could replace both expected path and expected digest, making verification internally consistent with caller-selected bytes despite the image lock authority claim.
finding.falsifier: Runtime path/digest values that differ from the embedded lock/path must fail before EntityOS binding.

covers: matching assertion acceptance without authority transfer

unusual_experiment.reason: This exact user go exposes no shared immutable request/turn id and only minute-precision immutable message time, so the atomic experiment lease cannot be uniquely reproduced.
